uncertainties: Panashe's doglike race Bawnas provisional pending research.
text:
You know Marurur
is bad at remembering names...
Subaru, huh?
You're an oni child, right?
Subaru, then.
Are you an oni child?
Yeah! I'm
a descendant of a clan
with the blood of an oni god!
Oh...
Oh, is that so?
Oh, Little Rascal!
Isn't Mr. Doggy
with you?
...Over there.
Uh...
Says humans are scary
and doesn't want to come close.
I'm not
scared!
Then come and
say hello
to Teacher!
Ugh...
You're
a demi-human child, then.
Are you
a demi-human child?
Y-yes...
I'm a Bawnas.
If I recall, that's
a doglike race.
If I recall, that's
a doglike race.
Yes! That's why
I call him Mr. Doggy!
I hope we'll get along.
I hope we'll get along.
Y-yeah.
You too, Subaru.
You too, Subaru.
Yeah!
Here we are!
This is the Maetropa settlement,
Yukres Village.
Marurur
lives here too! ♪
Yukres Village...
A village of people from Maetropa...
Yukres is
the name of the huge tree
at the edge of the village.
Mr. Stripes said
it listens
to your wishes!
Oh...
A demi-human settlement
isn't so different
from a human village.
Somehow, the atmosphere
reminds me
of my home village...
A demi-human settlement
isn't so different
from a human village.
Somehow, the atmosphere
reminds me
of my home village...
Teacher, do you
like
this village?
Yes, I do.
It's a lovely village
that puts me at ease.
Yes, somehow
it puts me at ease.
It's a lovely village.
I'm so glad! ♪
The Guardian here
is Mr. Stripes.
